lines: {target}? Black stone and lava leave little mercy. I would stay close enough to hear the bell.
If anyone heads for Basalt Deltas, tell them: Step like every block wants an argument. I will be at the bell.
Ash and basalt make the Nether feel broken twice. I'll remember that from near the bell.
Basalt Deltas is no small story. Running the wrong way is still running.
I will remember Basalt Deltas as as jagged black country with heat in its cracks. I will stay where I can hear the bell.
{target}? I would not rush toward it without telling someone where you are going first.
That kind of place makes a simple walk feel like a decision. Pack food, count your torches, and keep your head clear.
I have heard enough about {target} to know the quiet parts are usually the ones to worry about.
If you go there, come back with the story and not just the scratches. The village remembers both.
A place like {target} can turn confidence into <shake>panic</shake> very quickly.
